summary: Redis/Sentinel is operational across all three nodes with mutual TLS and password authentication. Node1 began as primary; failover promoted node3, and the reboot sequence later promoted node2. Final state: node2 primary, node1/node3 synchronized replicas, three-Sentinel quorum, and infra:proof=ready preserved.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Redis Server and Sentinel on all nodes.
Created a private CA, per-node certificates, and an administrative client certificate.
Stored protected administrative credentials in /root/redis-admin.env on node1.
Configured TLS-only Redis port 6379 and Sentinel port 26379 on cache-network addresses.
Verified automatic promotion and return of the former primary as a synchronized replica.
Restarted every node sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2 and node3 replicas; infra:proof=ready
evidence.summary: Node1 reported two online replicas; both replicas had an up link to node1; all nodes returned ready.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated mutual TLS for Redis and Sentinel with protected node1 credentials
evidence.summary: Unauthenticated requests returned NOAUTH, authenticated TLS requests returned PONG, missing client certificates were rejected, plaintext ports were disabled, and /root/redis-admin.env had mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Three Sentinels monitor infra-primary with quorum
evidence.summary: Each Sentinel reported three usable Sentinels, two replicas, and the infra-primary address.

evidence.requirement: Automatic promotion and recovered former primary synchronization
evidence.summary: Node1 Redis was stopped while Sentinel quorum remained; node3 became writable, and node1 returned as a synchronized replica with both proof values.

evidence.requirement: Final cluster health and persisted data
evidence.summary: Node2 is the final primary with two online replicas; every node has active/enabled Redis and Sentinel, TLS listeners, proof=ready, and three-Sentinel quorum.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, synchronized replica recovery, data, and quorum were captured.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, synchronized replica recovery, data, and quorum were captured.
Healthy primary baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovery as a synchronized replica of promoted node2, data, and quorum were captured.
